specs.title: Back and Forward restore settings and UTC controls, flushing the previous entry before selection
Back cancels an outstanding query replacement instead of corrupting the restored entry
accelerated playback and free camera gestures do not write URLs; share captures time and reloads paused
LIVE clears dated anchors through its transition; explicit pause/play and reverse record one anchor
Previous view and Backspace restore camera history by replacement, including a hidden target
closing and reselecting a card keeps the route and camera; canvas selection takes the shared command path
clipboard denial exposes a labelled selectable link and returns focus on mobile
compatibility navigation preserves semantic state and strips other diagnostics
obsolete asynchronous startup cannot replace a newer canvas after leaving and returning
production HTTP HTML contains catalog metadata for all 21 objects
friendly HTTP redirects validate state and retain only accepted flags
unknown objects, future kinds and unavailable events are HTTP 404 with no renderer
planet:mars supports direct entry and refresh
moon:europa supports direct entry and refresh
dwarf:pluto supports direct entry and refresh
star:sun supports direct entry and refresh
moon:charon supports direct entry and refresh
legacy root focus normalizes its path and metadata without a second restoration
20 client selections keep one engine/canvas and one focus per selection without restoration feedback, then dispose on exit
a selection during startup restores the latest route, and the standalone lab still works
settled production input/results and semantic selection respond within 300 ms
settled production input/results and semantic selection respond within 300 ms
all 21 names, IDs and catalog aliases are locally searchable with bounded deduplicated options
combobox arrows, Home and End keep input focus and Enter selects the active option rather than the first
prefix, typo and mixed-case results select coherent canonical routes
empty, unavailable and long input remain bounded and no-result Enter adds no history
IME composition does not select or dismiss; composition end commits the final query
Escape and keyboard dismissal return to the trigger without changing selection or clock
search yields background rendering without pausing simulation time, then resumes after dismissal and canonical selection
touch selects without hover and search stays usable in a shorter viewport
earth restores the actual camera reference with a wide, hidden-layer selection
helio restores the actual camera reference with a wide, hidden-layer selection
earth-fixed restores the actual camera reference with a wide, hidden-layer selection
public restoration is one cold command and does not add camera history
a fixed camera preserves pose when switched, then evolves the rendered view with time
unsupported state reports a command error while retaining the live renderer
invalid external time and settings recover to a LIVE overview
an offset date restores paused time and known layers outside the UTC browser timezone
malformed query encoding does not fail graphics and layers= remains all off
GPU readback keeps a LEO surface marker below half a pixel
LOW stays below the texture budget after twenty focus changes
phone-sized LAN HTTP origin hydrates and starts the compatibility renderer
a stalled startup shows a recoverable error instead of an endless loader
deterministic material reference views
